title: 'Soukou Kihei Votoms: Haiiro no Hexe' Unveils Cast Members, Additional Staff, Trailer
content: The official website of the Soukou Kihei Votoms: Haiiro no Hexe ( Armored Trooper Votoms: Die Graue Hexe ) anime unveiled the cast members, additional staff, and main trailer on Friday. The anime will premiere as two movies, with the first one scheduled to open in theaters on November 20.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Sakamoto Days Season 2 Introduces Three New Characters With a Trailer
content: SAKAMOTO DAYS Season 2 TV anime revealed a new character trailer ahead of the anime’s January 2027 release date. The first season made strong numbers at Netflix , and the sequel was announced shortly after its ending. The sequel will also have a new director, with Daisuke Nakajima taking over Masaki Watanabe.
author: Anime Corner

title: Netflix Reveals New Updates for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners S2, THE ONE PIECE, Blue Eye Samurai, Bass x Machina, and More
content: Netflix revealed a new slate of animation updates during Anime NYC, including release dates for CYBERPUNK: EDGERUNNERS 2 and Blue Eye Samurai Season 2, the first key visual for THE ONE PIECE , a character trailer SAKAMOTO DAYS Season 2, and more for several upcoming projects.
author: Anime Corner

title: Fool Night Anime by SHAFT and SUNRISE Reveals November 26 Premiere, New Trailer, English Voice Cast
content: FOOL NIGHT anime adaptation by studios SHAFT and SUNRISE revealed a new trailer and additional voice cast members, as well as a November 26 premiere. This is the first-ever joint project between the two studios, and it was previously confirmed for a 2026 release exclusive to Netflix.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Fool Night' Reveals Additional Cast, Second Teaser Promo, November 2026 Premiere
content: The Netflix panel at Anime NYC 2026 revealed additional cast members and a second teaser promotional video for the anime adaptation of Kasumi Yasuda 's Fool Night manga on Thursday. The anime will debut worldwide exclusively on Netflix on November 26.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Fool Night Anime's Teaser Reveals More Cast, November 26 Worldwide Netflix Debut
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks unveiled a new teaser trailer for the television anime of Kasumi Yasuda 's Fool Night manga on Friday. The teaser revealed more cast and the November 26 worldwide Netflix debut date for the anime. Netflix will debut the entire series on November 26.
author: ANN

title: THE ONE PIECE Remake by WIT Studio Reveals First Key Visual
content: THE ONE PIECE anime remake by WIT Studio has revealed its first key visual ahead of its February 2027 release date. The anime previously confirmed that Mayumi Tanaka will reprise the role of Luffy in the new anime, teasing it with a teaser trailer .
author: Anime Corner
